name: luxury-red-lip-grid-campaign
image_purpose: cosmetics campaign and editorial beauty grid

prompt.project_info: Create a perfectly aligned 3x3 luxury red-lip cosmetics campaign using one consistent adult face reference and one consistent lipstick product.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman using the required approved-adult face reference; preserve identical facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, cheekbones, and natural skin texture in every panel. She wears a blue tailored blazer, white shirt, red necktie, red acetate eyeglasses, sleek ponytail, red manicure, and bold high-pigment red lipstick.
prompt.composition_elements: 3x3 square grid with even margins and deep red solid background: smiling lipstick near mouth; side angle applying lipstick; side glance with lipstick near cheek; laughing while lifting glasses; extreme lip close-up; side profile; hands-only crossed lipsticks; three-quarter portrait; extreme eye close-up behind glasses. Same generic black lipstick tube with replaceable minimal white label across all panels.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft but contrasty studio lighting even across panels, subtle highlights on skin and lipstick, luxury cosmetics advertising finish, realistic pores and makeup texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Nine square aligned panels, hyper-realistic high resolution, crisp product and skin detail, no face drift, no unintended text, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Luxury red-lip cosmetics 3x3 grid campaign using the required approved-adult face reference, preserving identical facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, cheekbones, and natural skin texture in every panel. Deep solid red background, nine aligned square panels: smiling lipstick near mouth; side angle applying lipstick; side glance with lipstick near cheek; laughing while lifting glasses; extreme lip close-up; side profile; hands-only crossed lipsticks; three-quarter portrait; extreme eye close-up behind glasses. Same generic black lipstick tube with replaceable minimal white label in every panel, soft contrasty studio lighting, luxury editorial beauty campaign, crisp realistic texture.

assets.usage: Required approved-adult face reference plus visual reference for blazer, tie, glasses, lipstick, deep-red background, nine-panel layout, and product placement.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult face reference. Preserve identity, outfit, makeup, product, panel order, background, and lighting consistently. Use generic replaceable lipstick branding; do not invent readable label text, logos, or typography.
